Markus — quick ops/finance check:

1) Split invoicing: OK. Finance can issue two invoices tied to a single amendment/SOW; revenue recognition will treat the uplift across the two invoice dates. We should add a short note to the amendment indicating "Uplift payment to be invoiced in two installments: 50% due on execution, 50% due 45 days later." That preserves clarity.

2) Voucher: We confirmed the voucher code "NP-POC-2026" is valid and currently marked for "next invoice credit." Legal prefers to explicitly assign the voucher to this amendment to avoid ambiguity; operationally fine as a one-time offset. We'll need to record it in billing with a unique credit reference.

3) Discounts: To keep ARR math clean, recommend we treat the voucher as an invoice-level credit rather than changing the list prices / discount bands. That keeps reporting simpler and prevents downstream PRICING system side effects.

4) Attachments / amendment: I've attached a draft amendment (Proposed_Amendment_v1.docx) that includes the split-invoice language and voucher application clause. Legal flagged two minor redlines but nothing blocking.

If you want me to be on the call with NovaPlus tomorrow at 10am PT I can join. Otherwise, Markus — you have the green light to confirm feasibility.

Cheers,
